chart_tabs._note: chart_id is stable across tab reorders. layout_name is for reference only. Update chart_id here if you create a replacement layout.

risk_rules: Never risk more than 1% of total account on a single trade
No trading in the first 15 minutes of the NYSE open (9:30-9:45 AM ET)
Maximum 5 open positions across all instrument types at once
If 3 consecutive losing trades in a day, stop trading for the day
notes: Symbols are sourced live from TradingView screeners. Run screener_get before morning_brief. Strategy-specific criteria (bias rules, entry/exit, indicators) live in strategy-{type}.json files.
